LearnerProfile.title: LearnerProfile
LearnerProfile.description: Authenticated learner settings and overall General American pronunciation readiness metrics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Learner display name shown in the studio header.

totalSessions.description: Total completed AI acoustic evaluation sessions.

overallClarityScore.description: Rolling clarity readiness score from 0 to 100.

preferredStartSpeed.description: Preferred progressive shadowing start speed multiplier (0.65 to 1.10).

focusPhonemeIds.description: Top weak GenAm phoneme identifiers currently prioritized in the feedback loop.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

PhonemeMastery.title: PhonemeMastery
PhonemeMastery.description: Per-phoneme General American mastery score, attempt history, and personalized coaching note.

phonemeId.description: Stable ASCII phoneme identifier matching the document ID.

category.description: Articulatory family label (e.g., Dental, Rhotic, Vowel).

masteryScore.description: Exponentially weighted moving average mastery score from 0 to 100.

attemptCount.description: Number of times this phoneme was evaluated.

recommendedSpeed.description: Recommended shadowing tempo multiplier for this phoneme (0.65 to 1.10).

recentIssueNote.description: Most recent physical articulation coaching tip detected by Gemini.

lastPracticedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest practice evaluation for this phoneme.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

PracticeSession.title: PracticeSession
PracticeSession.description: Immutable log of a completed shadowing take and multimodal AI acoustic evaluation.

phraseId.description: Identifier of the shadowed phrase or generated drill.

phraseText.description: The General American English sentence practiced.

targetPhonemes.description: Bounded list of target phoneme IDs evaluated in this take.

speedMultiplier.description: Shadowing tempo multiplier used during the take.

overallScore.description: Overall acoustic intelligibility score from 0 to 100.

rhythmScore.description: Syllable stress and rhythm sub-score from 0 to 100.

flowScore.description: Connected speech flow sub-score from 0 to 100.

nextStepRecommendation.description: Recommended next tempo or articulatory focus.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-scoped learner profile storing readiness index, streak, and preferred shadowing speed.

/users/{userId}/phonemeMastery/{phonemeI.description: Owner-scoped per-phoneme General American mastery metrics driving the personalized feedback loop.

/users/{userId}/practiceSessions/{sessio.description: Owner-scoped append-only history of AI acoustic evaluations and shadowing sessions.
